note: Phase-12B second held-out. NOT in Ph9/10 vector or Ph11/12A panels. Course response→progression (gold SATISFIED) + one contradiction + one no-failure. Tests pre-declared LOW/HIGH margin bands from Ph12A. Wording accepted 2026-08-25.

cases.why: ABVD response then progression; switch to salvage.
cases.evidence: Classical Hodgkin lymphoma: first-line ABVD for four cycles with metabolic response on interim PET, then progressive disease with new FDG-avid nodes before cycle 6. Discontinued ABVD for progression; referred for salvage ICE.

cases.why: R-CHOP response then POD; second-line start.
cases.evidence: Follicular lymphoma grade 2: first-line R-CHOP achieved partial response after three cycles, then clear progression of disease with rising LDH and enlarging nodes at restaging. Stopped R-CHOP for POD; started second-line bendamustine-rituximab.

cases.why: 7+3 induction response then morphologic relapse; reinduction planned.
cases.evidence: AML: completed induction 7+3 with day-14 marrow showing clearing blasts and clinical response, then morphologic relapse with 25% blasts before consolidation. Held planned consolidation for relapse; planned reinduction with MEC.

cases.why: Note denies prior lines vs pharmacy documents completed induction.
cases.evidence: CART eligibility note: patient is treatment-naive for large B-cell lymphoma. Same-day pharmacy summary: completed six cycles first-line R-CHOP with CR documented on PET; proceed to lymphodepletion for axi-cel.

cases.why: Ongoing first-line with response; no failure.
cases.evidence: Multiple myeloma: cycle 3 of first-line Dara-RVd with ongoing partial response and falling free light chains. Continue current regimen; no progression or intolerance documented.
